repairs.quote: Zaahen gains a stack of Determination when he hits an enemy champion with an Attack or Ability (max 12). He gains (1.5% ~ 2.8%) increased Attack Damage per stack. When filled with Determination, Zaahen doubles the granted Attack Damage, and if he would die, he instead enters Stasis for 4 seconds then revives with (30% ~ 75%) of his max Health. Zaahen's revive has a (300 ~ 120) second Cooldown.
